title: Product Designer career roadmap
summary: A focused plan to solidify core design fundamentals, build a compelling portfolio, and prepare you for product design roles. Follow the phases to gain practical skills, showcase real work, and land your next opportunity.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Establish a strong base in product thinking and research fundamentals.

milestones.title: User research foundations
milestones.outcome: Can plan and conduct basic user research and synthesize findings.

tasks.title: Watch Nielsen Norman research video
tasks.description: View the free NNGroup video on qualitative research methods.

tasks.title: Create a research plan template
tasks.description: Design a one-page research plan template in Google Docs covering goals, methods, and participants.

tasks.title: Conduct 3 quick interviews
tasks.description: Interview three friends about a daily task, record notes, and identify patterns.

tasks.title: Summarize insights
tasks.description: Write a 200-word insight summary highlighting key user needs.

phases.title: Core skills
phases.summary: Develop interaction design, visual design, and collaboration abilities.

milestones.title: Metrics for designers
milestones.outcome: Can define, track, and interpret design metrics to inform decisions.

tasks.title: Read metric basics article
tasks.description: Read the free article on design metrics from Smashing Magazine.

tasks.title: Identify KPI set
tasks.description: Choose three relevant KPIs for a hypothetical e-commerce checkout flow.

tasks.title: Create a metric dashboard mockup
tasks.description: Design a simple dashboard in Figma showing the chosen KPIs over time.

tasks.title: Explain metric impact
tasks.description: Write a brief explanation of how each KPI would guide design iterations.

phases.title: Proof of work
phases.summary: Apply your skills to create portfolio-ready case studies.

milestones.title: Design Sprint write-up
milestones.outcome: A documented design sprint process showcasing rapid problem solving.

tasks.title: Plan a 5-day sprint schedule
tasks.description: Outline activities for each day, aligning with the Google Sprint framework.

tasks.title: Facilitate sketching session
tasks.description: Run a quick sketching workshop with peers and collect 20 ideas.

tasks.title: Prototype top idea
tasks.description: Build a high-fidelity prototype of the chosen concept in Figma.

tasks.title: User test prototype
tasks.description: Conduct 3 rapid usability tests and note key feedback.

tasks.title: Summarize sprint outcomes
tasks.description: Write a 500-word sprint recap highlighting decisions and next steps.

phases.title: Getting ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced collaboration skills and prepare for job or freelance opportunities.

milestones.title: Portfolio presentation & job prep
milestones.outcome: Ready to showcase work confidently and navigate the hiring process.

tasks.title: Build a portfolio site
tasks.description: Use a free website builder (e.g., Webflow) to create a clean portfolio layout.

tasks.title: Create case study pages
tasks.description: Add the three case studies with images, process steps, and outcomes.

tasks.title: Practice interview storytelling
tasks.description: Write and rehearse answers for three common product design interview questions.

tasks.title: Network with designers
tasks.description: Reach out to five designers on LinkedIn for informational chats.

tasks.title: Gather feedback on portfolio
tasks.description: Ask a senior designer to review your site and note improvement areas.
